Subject: StellarBank: Executive workshop — May/June scheduling & format

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. StellarBank would like to move forward with an executive workshop to align on deployment, risk profile, and runbook for a pilot. High-level asks:

- Two-day workshop (half-day exec brief + 1 day hands-on breakouts)
- Preferred window: late May or early June — we’re aiming for the week of Jun 8 or Jun 14
- Attendees: 8–10 (mix of product, infra, security, and procurement)
- Format: ideally onsite in SF (StellarBank HQ) but we can do a hybrid setup for remote execs

Can you confirm Redwood’s availability for those windows, and whether you can hold tentative calendar blocks for both onsite and virtual formats while we finalize approvals? Also: do you typically provide a hotel room block and travel contingency guidance for executive-level attendees?

I attached a quick needs doc with initial constraints and attendee roles.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20m sync if useful.

Erin Wallace
Head of Cloud Partnerships
StellarBank
Erin.wallace@stellarbank.com
(415) 555-0198

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Erin Wallace <erin.wallace@stellarbank.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-03T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: StellarBank: Executive workshop — May/June scheduling & format

Hi Erin — great to hear and congrats on momentum. We can support the two-day format and will hold tentative blocks while you finalize approvals. A few concrete items to speed planning: 

1) Date windows: we have full availability the week of Jun 8 (Mon–Thu) and limited availability week of Jun 14. If you can prioritize Jun 8–9 that will be easiest for our execs.

2) Format & timeline suggestion (we recommend):
   - Day 1 (AM): Executive briefing (60–90m) — leadership + security
   - Day 1 (PM): Joint architecture review + rollout risk discussion
   - Day 2: Breakouts (platform adoption, cost ops, SRE runbook)

3) Calendar holds: we’ll create two holds on our side: one for onsite SF (with travel window +/-1 day) and a parallel virtual hold in case approvals limit travel. Please confirm headcount and any visa/air-travel restrictions for the attendees who may need international travel.

4) Logistics we’ll provide: hotel block recommendation, an on-site AV checklist, a point-of-contact for attendee arrivals, and a light travel contingency plan (delays, last-minute virtual pivot).

I’m CC’ing Lauren Bishop (Eng Programs) to assist with travel/hotel and Marissa Cole (Events Ops) for rooms/AV. Lauren — can you draft a hotel block and share typical executive room rate sheet? Marissa — can you confirm which AV kit we should plan for hybrid rooms at StellarBank HQ?

Looping Tom Lopez (StellarBank) as well would help finalize attendee list and any corporate travel policy constraints.

If helpful, I can propose exact calendar slots by end of day and include timezone conversions for APAC attendees.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Director | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

Attachment: proposed_agenda_v0.1.pdf
